name: Threads (Meta)
one_liner: Meta's Threads social platform API for publishing posts, replies, insights, and keyword search.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Short-lived token (1 hour) is exchanged for a 60-day long-lived token that can be refreshed. Scopes are granular, for example threads_basic and threads_content_publish.
access_notes: Free. A Meta app plus your own Threads account as a tester works the same day for your own account. Accessing other people's accounts in production needs Meta's App Review.

buildability.rationale: Free OAuth 2.0 API, testable on your own account. Serving other users in production requires App Review per permission, which the pages describe as needing a screencast. Official Meta docs were not fetched.

identity.quote: The Threads API is Meta's official, free REST API for Threads.

auth.quote: Users authorize your app, you swap the code for a short-lived token (1 hour)

access.quote: You can build and test against your own account the same day. Accessing other people's accounts in production needs Meta's App Review.

api_surface.quote: served from graph.threads.net (also graph.threads.com) at version v1.0, and secured with OAuth 2.0

mcp.quote: This project is a TypeScript-based Node MCP (Model Context Protocol) Server that would create post to Threads

buildability.quote: Accessing other people's accounts in production needs Meta's App Review.

needs_human_reason: The cached pages are a third-party guide and a community repo. The official Meta developer docs were not fetched, so the canonical docs URL, rate limits, and App Review timing are unverified.
